summary_1line: Vishwamitra explains the origins of Ganga and Uma, Shiva’s marriage to Parvati, and the gods’ fear of their potential offspring’s overwhelming power.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Himavat stands beside Queen Mena as their radiant daughters Ganga and Uma shine with celestial beauty among the snowy Himalayan peaks.
The gods gather before Lord Shiva and Parvati, pleading with folded hands for him to restrain his immense divine power.
Shiva releases his blazing seed onto the earth, spreading across mountains, forests, and seas while the gods watch in alarm.
